reachability: Runs once at deploy. It pins the pool manager and hands ownership to `_owner` (PerpMarkSource.sol:93) through the base constructor; `armed` (PerpMarkSource.sol:72) stays false, so `armed` (PerpMarkSource.sol:159) returns 0 until a primary is set. A zero tick read by an armed engine would be a real price, but the engine only reaches this contract once an owner has wired it at `markSource` (PerpEngine.sol:1727). DERIVED.

The per-relaunch re-point. Setting a primary also CLEARS the sibling set at `pools` (PerpMarkSource.sol:103), because a new generation's pools have nothing to do with the old one's. There is no check that the key names a pool that exists or that its currencies match the engine's `_key` (PerpEngine.sol:482), so a mis-set primary silently becomes the mark the engine liquidates against. DERIVED.

Adds a sibling whose depth counts toward the mark. Four refusals: not armed at `armed` (PerpMarkSource.sol:112); the cap of `MAX_POOLS` (PerpMarkSource.sol:113); a currency pair that differs from the primary's in either slot at `WrongPair` (PerpMarkSource.sol:117) - the check that keeps a cross-quote oracle off the liquidation path; and duplicates, both against the primary at `primary` (PerpMarkSource.sol:120) and against the existing set in the loop at `pools` (PerpMarkSource.sol:123). Fee tier and tick spacing are free to differ, which is the same-quote depth-splitting case this exists for.

Swap-and-pop removal of a sibling; reverts `NotFound` (PerpMarkSource.sol:143) if the key is not in the set. The primary is not in `pools` (PerpMarkSource.sol:134) and so can never be removed - only replaced through `setPrimary` (PerpMarkSource.sol:100). Removing narrows what the mark averages, which is why it is documented as safe at any time.

Size of the sibling set, excluding the primary. The only external reader of the set's cardinality; the engine never calls it, since `weightedTick` (PerpMarkSource.sol:158) takes no arguments precisely so the engine need not know the pool count. DERIVED.

The engine's mark source, reached only through the hand-rolled staticcall at `staticcall` (PerpEngine.sol:542). Fallback order, most to least specific: (1) not armed - return 0 at `armed` (PerpMarkSource.sol:159); (2) no siblings - return the primary's tick at `primaryTick` (PerpMarkSource.sol:165); (3) no in-range liquidity anywhere - return the primary's tick at `totalL` (PerpMarkSource.sol:185); (4) otherwise the liquidity-weighted average at `acc` (PerpMarkSource.sol:186). Each sibling with zero in-range depth is skipped at `l` (PerpMarkSource.sol:176), so a drained pool contributes no weight. The primary is weighted even when its own liquidity is zero, since its tick seeds `acc` (PerpMarkSource.sol:171) before the loop. Note case (1): an armed-false source returns tick 0, which the engine accepts as a valid answer. DERIVED.
observations: comment at `generationQuote` (PerpMarkSource.sol:18) says the engine's `_sqrtP` reads slot0 of the one pool built from the registry's generation quote; the code at `quote` (PerpEngine.sol:483) builds that key from the engine's own CACHED quote storage slot, which `quote` (PerpEngine.sol:1099) is the only writer of.
